_om: Mimen in English (Charades, rusj.no/en/charades/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. An «oppgave» is a card to act out; «mimeren» is the one acting. The cards are in data.en/oppgaver.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Easy cards – good when the kids are playing.
Lette og middels oppgaver – passer for d: Easy and medium cards – right for most groups.
Middels og vanskelige – for drevne mimer: Medium and hard – for seasoned actors.
Dere er mange – da går det raskest med l: There are lots of you – teams are quickest.
Bare laget til mimeren gjetter, og poeng: Only the actor's team guesses, and the points go to the team.
Mimeren får ett poeng for hver oppgave d: The actor gets a point for every card the others guess.
Den som gjetter først, får ett poeng – o: Whoever guesses first gets a point – and so does the actor.
Lyder er lov – men ingen ord: Sounds are allowed – but no words
Topp fem av {n}. Hele lista kommer på sl: Top five of {n}. The full list comes at the end.
{lag} klarte det på {n} s. To poeng til: {lag} got it in {n} s. Two points to the team!
{lag} klarte det på {n} s. Ett poeng til: {lag} got it in {n} s. A point to the team!
{navn} gjettet det på {n} s. To poeng ti: {navn} guessed it in {n} s. Two points to the guesser and two to the actor!
{navn} gjettet det på {n} s. Ett poeng t: {navn} guessed it in {n} s. A point to the guesser and one to the actor!
Ingen poeng denne gangen. Den var kanskj: No points this time. Maybe that one was a bit tricky?
The clock won this time. No points.
Den runden var vrien. Neste tur blir bed: That one was tricky. Next turn will be better!
{navn} delte seieren i mimeleken med {po: {navn} shared the win at charades with {poeng} each!
Én mimer, resten gjetter. Ingen ord, ing: One person acts, the rest guess. No words, no sounds – just arms, legs and faces.
Mimeren holder mobilen som et kort, så i: The actor holds the phone like a card so nobody else sees it. Tap start – and the clock is running.
Mim så mange du rekker: Act out as many as you can
Hurtigmim: Trykk «Riktig» hver gang de a: Speed charades: tap ‘Got it’ every time the others guess the card, or ‘Pass’ to skip it. The next card comes straight away.
Når tiden er ute, ser dere lista. Trykk: When time's up, you see the list. Tap a card to correct it. Every card guessed scores a point.
Én om gangen: én oppgave per tur. Mimere: One at a time: one card per turn. The actor holds a finger on the card to see it, and whoever guesses first scores as many points as the actor.
På middels og vanskelig får mimeren to o: On medium and hard, the actor gets two cards to choose from in ‘One at a time’. The harder one is worth two points.
Show how many words it is with your fingers. Tap your arm to show which word you're on.
Pek på øret når du vil si «det høres ut: Tug your ear when you want to say ‘sounds like …’.
Lag mot lag: bare laget til mimeren gjet: Team against team: only the actor's team guesses. Turn on ‘Sounds allowed’ when the little ones are playing.
Show it – without a single word.
Split into teams. The teams take turns to act.
Hvordan spiller dere?: How do you want to play?
Så mange oppgaver dere rekker på tiden: As many cards as you can in the time
Én oppgave per tur – fint for de minste: One card per turn – good for little ones
Each team acts once each round.
Mimeren velger mellom to oppgaver – den: The actor chooses between two cards – the harder one is worth two points.
Choose at least one category with cards.
Fint for de minste. Ord er fortsatt forb: Good for little ones. Words are still banned.
Hvem mimer? Den som mimer, holder mobile: Who's acting? The actor holds the phone like a card. The rest of the team guesses.
Bare mimeren ser skjermen: Only the actor sees the screen
Hold mobilen som et kort. Trykk «Riktig»: Hold the phone like a card. Tap ‘Got it’ for every card the others guess.
{n} sekunder – så mange dere rekker: {n} seconds – as many as you can
Velg den du tør. Klokka starter når du t: Pick the one you dare. The clock starts when you tap – put the phone down and act.
Klar? Trykk start, legg fra deg mobilen: Ready? Tap start, put the phone down and act.
Den som mimer, holder fingeren på kortet: The actor holds a finger on the card to see it. Everyone else looks away.
{navn} – hold fingeren på kortet for å s: {navn} – hold your finger on the card to see it. Everyone else looks away.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se de to o: Hold your finger on the card to see the two cards
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se oppgave: Hold your finger on the card to see what to act
Glemt oppgaven? Hold fingeren på kortet: Forgotten it? Hold your finger on the card to see it again
New record! The fastest guess was {n} s.
Oppgaven er skjult. Fortsett når {navn}: The card is hidden. Continue when {navn} is ready.
New record! The old one was {n} in {tid} s.
No cards were guessed this time. Well done anyway!
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den som lede: You'll go straight to the results. Whoever is in the lead now wins.
Ingen har fått poeng ennå, så det blir i: Nobody has scored yet, so there won't be any results.
